scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:wasm && vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build && node scripts/run-browser-tests.ts --config playwright.config.ts --project=client
scripts.test:browser:smoke: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:browser:smoke:prepared
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=performance
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm --workspace-root run contracts:check && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test:chat-settings: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance accounts-ui-smoke.spec
scripts.test:subagent-concurrency: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance subagent-concurrency-ui.spec
scripts.test:chat-status: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance agent-phase-browser.spec session-activity-browser.spec
scripts.test:reliability: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance draft-recovery-browser.spec sync-recovery-browser.spec message-retry-http-browser.spec
scripts.test:ux: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance questions-ux-ui.spec dialog-drafts-ui.spec realtime-voice-ux-ui.spec outbox-controls-ui.spec
scripts.test:ux-audit: pnpm --filter codex-agents-web exec vitest run --config ../desktop/vitest.config.mjs native-ux.test.mjs && pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance ux-chat-ui.spec messages-focused-ui.spec rendering-ux-ui.spec ux-support-ui.spec browser-dictation-ux.spec limit-recovery-state-ui.spec usage-resume-notice-ui.spec disconnect-recovery-ui.spec
scripts.test:mobile: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance mobile-client-ui.spec mobile-keyboard-ui.spec message-delivery-ui.spec chat-prefetch-browser.spec chat-prefetch-ui.spec mobile-sync-browser.spec sync-reset-browser.spec mobile-sync-cached-browser.spec mobile-request-deadline-browser.spec mobile-send-reliability-browser.spec mobile-send-reliability-ui.spec mobile-loading-ui.spec
scripts.test:restart: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance upload-recovery-browser.spec scroll-restart-browser.spec draft-recovery-browser.spec dialog-drafts-ui.spec mobile-send-reliability-ui.spec workspace-ui.spec
scripts.test:ux-recovery: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance ux-request-recovery-browser.spec account-project-ui.spec project-tree-ui.spec
scripts.test:display: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance ui-error-boundary-browser.spec
scripts.test:skill-autocomplete: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance skill-autocomplete-ui.spec
scripts.test:diagnostics: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance account-settings-errors-browser.spec structured-operational-errors-ui.spec native-error-ui.spec
scripts.test:responsiveness: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --project=performance draft-render-performance-browser.spec transcript-render-performance-browser.spec completed-markdown-cache-browser.spec scroll-restart-browser.spec ui-responsiveness-browser.spec
scripts.storybook: pnpm run build:wasm && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook dev --config-dir .storybook --disable-telemetry --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open
scripts.build-storybook: pnpm run build:wasm && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook build --config-dir .storybook --disable-telemetry
scripts.typecheck:focused: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run typecheck:fast
scripts.test:browser:smoke:prepared: node scripts/run-browser-tests.ts --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --grep "execution settings ui|Mobile composer 320px setup renders the settled action row|Message receipt pagination browser|a real built renderer uses a new projection cache and preserves drafts|accounts settings show per-server state and provider choices|direct screens keep overlapping chat drafts and sends with their owner|direct screens automatically include paired servers on phones|a scrolled-up reader keeps its place while the agent streams|Sign-in card at phone width uses paste mode and the device code|Claude unconfirmed turn and journal repair|transient (vault|auth) progress has zero (idle HTTP|job receipt) reads|bounded entities render initial and live changes with zero resource GETs|real IndexedDB staging removes crash orphans|rename (applied|failed) uses one POST and saved servers stay idle without status reads|composer model summary wraps on phones and opens the role settings|touch sidebar keeps separate stable targets and opens on the first tap|touch scrolling the sidebar does not activate a chat|mouse and keyboard each open once and the row menu stays distinct|desktop drag reorders without opening a chat and wheel scrolling stays native|sidebar project groups follow the current view without losing discovery|selected Studio chat recovers after slow cursor preparation without reloading"
